card.name: Ctrl key in software shortcuts
card.fires_on: The Ctrl (or Cmd/Ctrl) modifier key in keyboard shortcut instructions, mainly in image-editing tutorials. Weaker on Alt and similar key names.

modes.label: Ctrl in shortcuts
modes.description: The word Ctrl or ctrl, or its middle piece, naming a key to hold or press with another key.
modes.example: Right-click on this object and select Open Clip Effects Bin (keyboard shortcut:<< Ctrl>>+B)

modes.label: Alt and other key names
modes.description: Weak response on Alt, ALT or ESC as key names or as the start of words.
